products.seoTitle: SAMUHIA Products — Property, Schools, Chamas, Desk & Payments
products.description: Five operational SAMUHIA products forming one connected technology ecosystem: Plot Yangu, MyRegister, MyChama, Samuhia Desk and Samuhia Payments.
products.title: Five products. One ecosystem.
products.lead: Each SAMUHIA product serves a specific environment; Samuhia Payments connects them.

solutions.seoTitle: Solutions — Find the Right SAMUHIA Product for Your Operation
solutions.description: Start with your problem: property management, schools, chamas, agent desks, and rent and payment collection in Kenya.
solutions.title: Solutions for real operations.
solutions.lead: Start with the problem you need to solve and we will point you to the SAMUHIA product built for it.

features.seoTitle: Features: Landlord Watch and House to Rent | SAMUHIA
features.description: Landlord Watch gives agent-managed landlords a live view of rent. House to Rent lists vacant units on WhatsApp. Both are part of Plot Yangu.
features.title: Features that connect landlords, agents and tenants.
features.lead: Two Plot Yangu features built for how rental property works in Kenya: landlords who want visibility, and people who want a place to live.

pricing.seoTitle: Pricing — SAMUHIA Plans in Kenya Shillings
pricing.description: Plans and pricing for Plot Yangu, MyChama and MyRegister, plus how fees work for Samuhia Desk and Samuhia Payments. All prices in KES.
pricing.title: Pricing by product.
pricing.lead: Every plan is paid by M-Pesa. Plot Yangu includes a 3-month Business trial with no card, and MyRegister is free.
pricing.footnote: Prices are in Kenya shillings and can change. Confirm current prices in each app before you subscribe.

careers.title: Build income on the Samuhia network.
